description: Vantalumen is an interactive educational platform designed to tell the stories of space equipment left behind on and around the Moon and Mars. We teach users what happened to these machines, why they were important, and how they advanced humanity’s progress in space exploration. Knowing people learn differently, we tell those stories through three pillars: a sci-fi interactive website, minigames, and comics. Backed by official NASA data, all three experiences are grounded in real space science.
